title: My Family
subtitle: Talking about family members — for English learners

sentences.en: Hello! Let me tell you about my family.
sentences.target: Hello! Let me tell you about my family.

sentences.en: I have a mother, a father, and one brother.
sentences.target: I have a mother, a father, and one brother.

sentences.en: My mother's name is Ana and she is a teacher.
sentences.target: My mother's name is Ana and she is a teacher.

sentences.en: My father is called Carlos and he is a doctor.
sentences.target: My father is called Carlos and he is a doctor.

sentences.en: My brother is twelve years old and he likes soccer.
sentences.target: My brother is twelve years old and he likes soccer.

sentences.en: I also have two grandparents who live in the country.
sentences.target: I also have two grandparents who live in the country.

sentences.en: My grandmother makes the best food in the world.
sentences.target: My grandmother makes the best food in the world.

sentences.en: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
sentences.target: Do you have any brothers or sisters?

sentences.en: Yes, I have one sister. She is older than me.
sentences.target: Yes, I have one sister. She is older than me.
